rule.calib: next 200 images by sorted file name (disjoint from eval)
rule.crowded: remaining image with the most label lines (ties: first in sorted order)
rule.empty: first remaining image (sorted) with zero label lines; missing label file counts as zero
rule.eval: first 500 val2017 images by sorted file name
rule.remaining: all images after the eval and calib subsets; stream/empty/crowded may overlap each other
rule.stream: 50 of the remaining images (sorted), indices floor(i*N/50) for i in 0..49, N=remaining count
